name: personal-os
description: Local Personal OS MCP server: Finance read tools plus locally human-approved writes (Account, Transaction, Metric, Target, freee-mcp-mediated import). Runs the user's own personal-os git checkout via uv; no code or data is bundled in this extension.
long_description: This extension does not contain Personal OS's application code. It bundles a single thin launcher script that execs `uv --directory <repo> run python -m personal_os.adapters.mcp.runtime_server --enable-writes`, so it always runs whatever is currently checked out in the user's personal-os git repository. All personal data lives outside both the git repo and this extension, in ~/PersonalOS-data/, per the project's SECURITY.md. Every write tool requires a local macOS confirmation dialog before anything is committed.
